How It Works

We instantly create a private QR code for your event that saves all full resolution photos to your live photo gallery or albums.

How It Works For Guests

1. Guests Scan QR Code

With a quick scan of your QR Code, or a simple click of your private link, guests can instantly upload photos, videos, and guestbook messages.

Bonus: Invite your guests with our new Digital Invitation and RSVP tool.

Only takes 2 mins to create!

2. Upload Memories

Guests are greeted with your welcome screen where they add their name (so you know who’s accessed) and can immediately upload photos, videos and guest book messages. No guest registration needed. Compatible with any device.

3. Enjoy & Relive

You and your guests will love revisiting the best moments in your digital gallery.

As the host, you’re in complete control, with highly customizable settings to make the gallery perfectly tailored to your celebration.

Your gallery will be the go-to destination in the days and weeks after your event! 

Pricing

How It Works For Hosts

CREATE YOUR EVENT

After purchase, add your event date, event title, and a short welcome message for your guests. This will be your welcome page for guests once they scan your QR code or click your private link. For album packages, we recommend a separate album per event.

DISPLAY YOUR QR CODE

Display your QR code at your event. You can even copy and send your private link to guests digitally. Use our QR code generator to generate your personal dynamic QR Code with customized colors or use our default color scheme. 

ENJOY YOUR MEMORIES

You and your guests will love seeing the best moments roll into your digital gallery! As the host, you are in control. You can customize the features of GUESTPIX™ in whichever way suits you and your event.

Loved & Used For...
ENGAGEMENT PARTIES
BACHELORETTE
PROPOSALS
BRIDAL SHOWERS

features included in every gallery

unlimited photos & videos

Collect unlimited photos & videos from guests from every angle. You’ll be excited to see your event through the eyes of your guests.

live slideshow

Activate the slideshow and watch as photos are automatically added each rotation. It’s a great way to showcase your wedding for all to enjoy!

guestbook

Receive heartfelt written guestbook messages from your guests. It’s the perfect accompaniment to your photo collection.

video guestbook

The video guestbook is an interactive way to collect video messages from your event! Receive these in a segmented gallery.

QR code & private link

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from your wedding guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage and more! Or send your private link digitally.

180+ Canva templates

Receive links to 180+ Canva templates to edit and print locally with your QR code. Includes welcome sign, table cards, mini take-home cards and I Spy game.

digital gallery & albums

Enjoy the convenience of your own digital gallery. View photos, videos and guestbook messages, edit content and enjoy sharing with your guests.

zip download

Ready to download your wedding gallery? Everything is zipped and ready to download within 12 months of your event. It’s the perfect way to keep, share or print in the future.

All organized and delivered to you in full resolution so you don't miss a moment!

Event already over?

Simply send your private link to guests and start receiving photos and content instantly!

Buy Now

GUESTPIX™ x The Bridal Journey Podcast

Watch our founders interview with Andi Towner from The Bridal Journey

In this episode of The Bridal Journey Podcast, Andi Towner sits down with husband-and-wife founders Carla and Warwick Groves, the duo behind GUESTPIX™.

Carla and Warwick share the story of how their idea was born, how the rise of QR codes during COVID opened the door, and how a side project quickly snowballed into a global business used at over 1500,000 events across 100 countries.

They have ultimately changed the way the world captures and shares event memories.
